thew.translation: n. 肌(肉), 体力, 精神(或道德)力量

thewed.definition:
a. Furnished with thews or muscles; as, a well-thewed limb.
a. Accustomed; mannered.
thewed.translation: a. 有肌肉的；肌肉发达的；强壮的

thewless.translation: a. 肌肉不发达的, 体力虚弱的, 没有精神的, 懒惰的, 无活力的

thewy.definition:
a. Having strong or large thews or muscles; muscular; sinewy;
   strong.
thewy.translation: a. 肌肉发达的, 有力的
